# Disposable writing scratch

All names and content are invented. Runtime tests have NOT RUN. Use a fresh
generated vault for each destructive case; record the exact artifact receipt.
Type the examples below into the working sentence, rather than pasting this
whole note. Reopen the menu between independent tests.

## Working sentence

Today I spoke with [type a trigger here] about the next chapter.

## Reproductions

1. Type `@Sentinel`: People, Places, Project, Reading are four distinct sources.
   Dataview must be explicitly installed/enabled for the last two. If one source
   masks another, record a CURRENT failure before isolating a provider to proceed.
2. Type `@Atlas`: select each of four distinct targets and open the resulting
   link. Check the TARGET line. Enable aliases on Places/Reading, then repeat
   `@Navigator`. Test wikilinks and Markdown links from this nested Writing folder.
3. Type `@Zoë` and `@東京`, then `@Deep`. Toggle People recursion and aliases;
   compare disabled Places aliases (`@Quiet Room`). Narrow `@People Sentinel`
   and backspace to `@` to test query broadening.
4. Open `@Sentinel`, edit/remove a source in settings with the menu still open,
   then attempt its old selection. Rename/delete a Sentinel in the vault; retry.
5. With Templater explicitly enabled, type `@Fresh Person` and select New Person.
   Type `@Collision` for a collision; choose the renamed/failure/delayed variants
   for their cases. `/Person` opens the Template provider's naming modal: cancel
   via Escape and close button, then retry and double-select a new action.
6. For a delayed variant, edit OUTSIDE the trigger range, switch away and back,
   replace the document, delete the source, or unload Entities during its eight-second wait.
   Run these separately. Check both notes, created file, notices, and one-step undo.
   Also switch Template action type to insert, type `/Delayed`, and select
   Delayed Person (slash queries stop at spaces): the
   integration's active-editor mutation must be checked independently of links.
7. Test `:smile`, `/todo`, and `@Zoë 東京` using keyboard, touch, and IME in Source
   and Live Preview. Repeat in a popout where supported, then unload/re-enable.
8. Configure daily/weekly integration per the acceptance guide. Type
   `@2025-12-29`, `@2024-02-29`, `@2024-03-01`, `@2026-W01`, `@2026-W02`,
   `@2026-W00`, `@2026-W54`, and `@tomorrow`. Record clock/timezone and resolved paths.
9. In separate runs, point People at each `Cases/` subfolder. Check unrelated
   sources still work. Restore it, then test include filters `active` / `^false$`
   and `score` / `^0$`, exclude `absent` / `.+`, and an invalid regex `[`.
   Repeat with Dataview Projects. Test invalid-query UI feedback separately;
   CURRENT UI refuses to save it. For lookup failure, use a separate disposable
   run: fully quit Obsidian, edit Projects' saved query to `(`, and reopen.

Full setup, required recovery outcomes and evidence fields live in the
repository's `docs/recovery/runtime-acceptance.md`. These instructions describe
tests; they are not claims that CURRENT behavior passes.
